key_insight: Bayesian Kolmogorov-Arnold networks provide inspectable Reynolds-stress closures with separate epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty estimates.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports uncertainty-aware RANS predictions, including wind-farm wake corrections that transfer to unseen layouts.
method: Learn univariate spline functions with variational posteriors over spline coefficients.
Enforce invariance, symmetry and tracelessness through a tensor basis; encourage realisability with soft regularisation.
Propagate posterior samples through RANS, injecting aleatoric uncertainty as a spatially correlated field.
evidence_signal: A controlled regression benchmark and turbulence applications show a favorable accuracy–calibration balance for spline-coefficient posteriors, calibrated in-distribution uncertainty, and transfer to unseen wind-farm layouts.
watch_item: Under geometric extrapolation, epistemic uncertainty increases but remains insufficient to capture growing prediction errors, leaving the model overconfident.
paper_title: Bayesian Kolmogorov-Arnold networks for trustworthy Reynolds-stress closures
